title: LIVE/DEAD™ Fixable Near-IR Cell Viability Assay
protocol: Thaw Reagent A of the LIVE/DEAD™ Fixable Near-IR Dead Cell Stain Kit and add 50 µL DMSO (Component B) to make a 1 mM stock solution.
Resuspend the mixture by pipetting up/down gently and protect from light on ice before use.
Prepare a 1 µM working stock LIVE/DEAD solution in PBS.
Collect a cell pellet of 1x10^5 – 1x10^6 cells in a 15mL Falcon tube.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 1mL 4% paraformaldehyde in 1X PBS.
Fix cells for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge tubes at 2000 RPM for 4 minutes.
Wash pellets twice by centrifugation with excess 1X PBS. Discard supernatant in appropriate waste container.
Keep cell pellet at room temperature when using day-of or freeze in the -20°C until ready to be used.
Aspirate media from cells of interest and cells plated for the unstained control.
Rinse cells once in PBS.
Trypsinize cells using 300µL of trypsin and 150µL of trypsin in the basolateral and apical compartment of Transwell inserts, respectively.
Incubate for 4 minutes at 37°C.
Add 1 mL and 500 μL of appropriate cell media to the basolateral and apical compartment of Transwell inserts, respectively.
Rinse wells and inserts with 1 mL of appropriate cell media and add to respective Falcon tubes.
Centrifuge tubes at 2000 RPM for 4 mins.
Aspirate media from pellets.
Resuspend the unstained control pellet in 1 mL PBS.
Resuspend remaining cell pellets and dead cell pellet in 1 mL of 1 μM working stock LIVE/DEAD solution.
Transfer resuspended pellets to 5 mL Round-Bottom tubes.
Incubate tubes for 30 mins at 37 °C protected from light.
Proceed to flow cytometry on BD FACS.
Insert Dead control and select Preview to view side (SSC) and forward (FSC) scatter pattern for P1.
Select APC-Cy7 vs. FSC for P2 to draw negative gate and confirm positive gate.
Acquire 10,000 events in P1.
